extensions.name: Music
extensions.description: Play songs, playlists and your library on Apple Music, and sign in to Spotify for the app's music controls
extensions.author: GIAP

options.label: Apple Music
options.description: The assistant can play it for you, by voice or in chat.

options.label: Spotify
options.description: Played by hand, on its page, in the Spotify app, or with the music controls. The assistant never controls Spotify: Spotify's developer rules do not allow voice or AI control.

options.label: The player page, in your web browser
options.description: Apple Music's whole catalog, or Spotify as a device called Goose In A Pond.

options.label: The service's own app
options.description: The Music app on this Mac for Apple Music. The Spotify app, or another of your devices, for Spotify.

required_secrets.description: Needed before you can sign in to Spotify: its developer terms do not allow one app for every household, so each uses its own.
Optional. Sign in so the app's music controls and the Spotify player page can play Spotify. The assistant never controls Spotify: Spotify's developer rules do not allow voice or AI control.
Optional. Your own Apple Developer key for the Apple Music player page. Leave all three blank to use Jarida's shared credentials. Your 10-character Team ID.
Optional. Part of your own Apple Developer key; leave blank to use the shared credentials. The 10-character ID of your MusicKit key.

Optional. Part of your own Apple Developer key; leave blank to use the shared credentials. Paste the whole contents of the MusicKit .p8 file; it stays on this device and is never given to the extension.
